## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (0 errors, 0 warnings)
- [ ] Ran `npm run paraglide:compile` if `messages/*.json` changed
- [ ] Updated docs (`.meta/*`, `CLAUDE.md`) if behaviour/decisions changed
- [ ] No secrets or local `.data/` committed
- [ ] UI changes stay presentation-only (no `data.ts` / `server/*` imports in components)
